cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 66% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.03% · WTI +2.02% · Brent +2.64% · NatGas +3.20%. 66% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Refining & Downstream is doing the heavy lifting at +3.12%.

cards.headline: Refining & Downstream leads, Renewables & Solar lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Refining & Downstream at +3.12%; weakest is Renewables & Solar at -0.47%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: SEDG is the standout at -5.66%
cards.body: Leaders: VLO +3.93%, EQNR +3.44%, MPC +3.27%, DVN +2.80%, PR +2.67%. Laggards: SEDG -5.66%, EOSE -5.28%, LEU -5.05%, FLNC -4.72%.
